title: Paxos trusted-by marquee
description: A slim 74px row under the hero: a small grey 'trusted by' label on the left (desktop) and a slow, endless left-drifting line of customer names set as plain wordmarks, fading out at both edges. The loop takes about 55 seconds on desktop and 20 on phones.
notes: names are plain text in the display font; pass ReactNode items for real logos
the loop stops under reduced motion (the row then wraps)
name: paxos-logos
